input.quote: 12.4 Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
input.rationale: § 12.4 binds only Customer with a no-hire ("solicit, hire, or employ") covering all Vendor employees for 24 months post-term, and expressly negates any unsolicited-approach or general-advertising carve-out ("regardless of how the employee applies"). That triggers all three walk-away conditions and contradicts § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no no-hire commitment and may hire anyone responding to general recruitment. Rather than deleting the paragraph outright (which left no compliant covenant text on the page), we replace it with the playbook fallback: mutual, solicitation-only, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, twelve (12) months from the end of that involvement, with express general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire. Our preferred position (deletion) is preserved as the negotiating ask in the comment.

proposal.summary: Replace one-way 24-month no-hire with mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to Services personnel, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept § 12.4 as drafted: it is a one-way no-hire ("solicit, hire, or employ") covering all Vendor employees for twenty-four months and expressly overriding unsolicited applications, which also contradicts § 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges we have made no no-hire commitment and may hire anyone responding to general recruitment). We have replaced it with a mutual non-solicitation limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, running twelve (12) months from the end of that involvement, with carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches and no no-hire element; our preference remains to delete the clause entirely.

ops.oldText: 12.4 Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
ops.newText: 12.4 During the term and for twelve (12) months after the end of the relevant individual's involvement in the Services, neither party will knowingly solicit for employment any employee of the other party who was directly involved in performing or receiving the Services. This restriction is limited to solicitation and imposes no restriction on hiring or engaging (no no-hire): either party may hire or engage any person who responds to a general advertisement or other recruitment campaign not specifically targeted at the other party's personnel, who approaches that party on his or her own initiative, or whose employment with the other party has already ended.
